name: Fitness Bot
tagline: Training and nutrition coaching that starts from your goal, your kit, and your form
description: It asks what you are training for and what equipment you own, then builds around that: weights with light conditioning by default, ordinary food over supplements, and gear picks only if you ask. A photo or clip of a lift gets a form breakdown. Estimates throughout, and explicit that it is not medical advice.
author: DannyGrinberg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
